setup: Feed the capture path a raw, un-curated blob (as if asking the server to summarize it itself).
action: Drive capture with raw content and observe whether the server transforms/summarizes it.
expected: The server does NOT summarize or transform via inference; it stores the client-provided curated line verbatim, or rejects a non-curated blob (never generates a summary itself).
pass: 1.0 only if no server-side summarization occurs. Any server-generated summary == 0.0 (hard cull).
